reviews.title: Simple and fun design but
reviews.text: I wish they’d make some options that don’t distort every single photo you want to feature

reviews.title: Expensive & lacks features.
reviews.text: For $40.00 it creates a slide show, it’s limited on using your own music, you can’t add titles to the beginning or the end, can’t use full Frame, you can only use one frame format for the entire video so vertical and horizontal shots have to be cropped, I had to re-edited the video in my “Vixer”App. Horrible!!!

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Tried twice now keeps crashing and then have to start again as lost all photos!!!

reviews.title: Too Fast
reviews.text: It gave me a sick headache with all the fast flashing. I couldn’t figure out how to slow it down. No time to look at each photo. Too fast. Deleted.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: I had to create a memorial video for a member of our family that passed. After working on the project for days, I still couldn’t get the cringy porn music to turn off and after downloading the project, it wouldn’t play the videos that were a part of it. A waste of time and emotional energy at a difficult time.

reviews.title: No response to problems
reviews.text: On several occasions since I renewed my VIP annual membership in January (now May), I have not received any response to my emails regarding issues I have encountered. I longer have any confidence in this product. Previously, I  I would get a resolution to the same problem.  I cannot recommend this app.

reviews.text:
Not only does it keep shaving an entire minute and a half off of my videos, but the effects work in landscape mode but when you try to do a vertical video they freeze at different points in the 
video!  wasted a LOT of time on videos that kept shaving more than a minute off!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: It was fun until my yearly subscription has been cut short by 6 months?????

reviews.title: Not working!
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years but lately when I go to save my video it tells me to subscribe and I’ve already subscribed to the VIP subscription. Also none of my past videos I’ve saved from projects I’ve worked on are no longer in my saved videos. All the time I’ve spent editing photos GONE!! Idk what has happened. I’ve upgraded several times and it shows my payment has progressed but it still won’t let me save the video I did and the Subscription needed page keeps popping up when again I already paid and did. I reported this to Apple app support just now. And pray this gets resolved!

reviews.title: Used to be 5+ stars
reviews.text: I used to love this app. The fact that even I get to the end and have taken so much time to gather the pictures and edit the ones that need it, put them in order of how I want them to go, find the effect I want on it, go to add the music and pay for multiple apps, songs, etc. trying to get the song I want on it and then it just freezes. It says just loading (has the dots showing it is loading) I let it sit there for over 4 minutes multiple times but can’t get into it and can’t even exit I have to close the app completely. I’ve tried so many times but it does the same thing every time.

reviews.title: MoShow
reviews.text: I had canceled the subscription before they could charge me. Apple was still charging me. They are still trying to charge me for it. I have spoken to Apple Support # through the phone and through the chat and they have not done anything. They keep trying to charge me $42 when I tell them that I canceled the subscription that I did not want the subscription and they still managed. To renew it without my knowledge and try to rob me of the $42. I think this is wrong. I’ve complained about it several times. Nothing has been done. I don’t think it’s right that Apple is still trying to charge me for something that I physically canceled before the trial was over and now because of this I cannot access any of my apps. I cannot renew the other app that I have like my Apple Music and my Apple TV because of this matter, I think Apple needs to fix the situation and not be so quick to take money from people who do not have it after they canceled something before the subscription could be even renewed how Apple could let something like that happen is wrong and I hope that this does not continue in the future and that it does get fixed
